notes: THIN: two dated 2026-27 items, one a true theme night open to all fans (Diwali, Nov 3) and one a theme ticket package (Naruto Night, Jan 5), which on its own is BORDERLINE-class. Per-game sponsor_name (17 games) and alternate_jersey black_skate (13 games) fields are presenting-sponsor and jersey annotations, BORDERLINE-class, not counted. The 6 undated refs are recurring theme nights named on community.canucks.com (Black History Month, Lunar New Year, Pride, Celebration of Women in Sport, Filipino Heritage, Hockey Fights Cancer) whose pages still carry 2025-26 content; expect them to be re-dated through news releases like Diwali. Our data showing zero is a real miss for at least Diwali Night.
